import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the CSV to one total per month.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)[['revenue', 'orders']].sum().sort_values('month')

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
ax2 = ax1.twinx()

line1, = ax1.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['revenue'], marker='o', label='Revenue')
line2, = ax2.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['orders'], marker='s', label='Orders', color='tab:orange')

ax1.set_xlabel('Month')
ax1.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax2.set_ylabel('Orders')
ax1.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax2.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax1.set_title('Monthly Revenue and Orders')
ax1.legend([line1, line2], [line1.get_label(), line2.get_label()], loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
